about: Records scripts/batch_read.py never sends or fetches, each with its reason. Task E's 10 papers are added here by id at Task E's start (Sprint 17 plan).

records.huang-2023-noise-resilient-single-pixel-: 2026-11-07: its record is the Research Square preprint (DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-3349937/v1), but the free copy fetched for it is byte-identical (sha256 ce38e989...) to the published paper saved for li-2024-noise-resilient-single-pixel-compressive (Communications Physics, DOI 10.1038/s42005-024-01603-y). A read would credit the published text to the preprint record and pay twice. Li 2024 is read; the two records are a version pair for the coordinator.
